Name: Æthertech
Desc:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+8%</>.
After the wearer applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+8%</> for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target has 4 stacks of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains an additional <@ba.pd>Physical DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+16%</> for 10s. This effect cannot stack.
